commits.summary: bind paired evaluations to exact run identity
gate team benefit on paired run alignment

iteration.area: Matched Single/Team evaluation identity and safe resume
changes: Paired reports require the production Single and Team execution modes, matching nonempty model and batch labels, exact case/repetition sets, and no malformed or pending matrix cells.
Added a run-contract SHA-256 over selected task definitions, permission/checker identity, effective repetitions, timeouts, model-call budgets, and suite defaults.
Run directories now reject resumed journals with changed or missing model, executor, batch, run-contract, or evaluator executable identity.
Reports carry the evaluator executable SHA-256; paired reports with missing or different binaries cannot enable Team benefit.
Corrected the architecture document: Single shares completion DTOs and receipt contracts with Team, but still has a separate persistence and lifecycle implementation.

validation.cargo_or_tests: not run; reserved for one final verification pass after implementation stabilizes

resources.disk_probe: Win32_LogicalDisk did not return T: in this environment

remaining: Evaluator binary identity does not prove the source Git revision or provider endpoint; freeze/source and endpoint identity must be bound before making a formal advantage claim.
Single and Team still have separate lifecycle/persistence implementations around shared completion DTOs; continue converging the host acceptance path without weakening permissions or review.
Review WorkerRuntime assembly and generic task-pool/template costs from current source.
Run the single final resource-policy-compliant validation only after source changes stabilize; perform matched live runs only with valid model access and record real outcomes.
